messages:
Tariq: Hey team, Enterprise client sent the auth checklist. They want clear answers for SAML attribute mapping, SCIM incremental behaviour, burst limits, RBAC provisioning flow, domain ownership proof, and whether Hosted vs Dedicated affects login fallback. Also need a POC pricing direction. @Greta @Hiro can you help?

Greta: SCIM defaults: delta_window=900s (15m). On Dedicated we can lower to 300s; for short trials we can temporarily allow 60s but will monitor. Default rate_limit=300 req/min/tenant; POC bump to 600 req/min available for up to 14 days with notice. Recommend batch endpoint for initial seed.

Hiro: SAML/RBAC: we read roles from SAML attribute `roles` and map via an explicit table in the Console. SCIM groups can map to roles too. We never auto-promote to org_admin without explicit mapping. Delegated-admin mode is opt-in and emits extra audit logs. Example mapping: `idp:Admin -> platform_admin`, `idp:Read -> viewer`.

Lina: Domain verification: DNS TXT (recommended), HTTP token, or signed SAML metadata. For email subdomains DNS TXT is fastest.

Tariq: Security also asked: if IdP is down, can users still log in? Need a one-liner for questionnaire.

Hiro: One-liner: "Optional email magic-link fallback is available when enabled; on Dedicated this requires outbound email and may be restricted by customer network/KMS policies. All fallback events are logged."

Greta: Hosted vs Dedicated summary for Sales: functionally equivalent for SSO/OIDC + SCIM. Dedicated adds private KMS, VPC egress control, and tunable SCIM limits. Hosted POC = usage + trial credits; Dedicated = short reserved commit sized by throughput. Sales: collect expected users, daily deltas, groups, and peak sync QPS.

ops-bot: Staging tenant scheduled for POC on 2026-07-15T02:00:00Z.

sec-bot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire PDF and sample SCIM config before sending to customer.

Tariq: Action items: @Greta provide SCIM config snippet + temporary SLA; @Hiro provide role-mapping doc and the one-line; Sales to collect sizing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
